messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The Customer Service Representative sends a Mortgage offer to the customer and waits for a reply. If the customer calls or writes back declining the mortgage, the case details are updated and the work is then archived prior to cancellation. If the customer sends back the completed offer documents and attaches all prerequisite documents then the case is moved to administration for completion. If all pre-requisite documents are not provided a message is generated to the customer requesting outstanding documents. If no answer is received after 2 weeks, the case details are updated prior to archive and cancellation.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="MortgageOfferProcess" name="Mortgage Offer Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Receive Mortgage Request">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send Mortgage Offer to Customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForReply" name="Wait for Reply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Reply" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckResponse" name="Check Response Type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decline</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAnswer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <!-- Decline Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_SendOffer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Event_WaitForReply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision" sourceRef="Event_WaitForReply" targetRef="Gateway_CheckResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decline" name="Declined" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckResponse" targetRef="Task_UpdateCaseDecline">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">response == 'decline'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateCaseDecline" name="Update Case Details (Declined)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArchiveDecline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchiveDecline" sourceRef="Task_UpdateCaseDecline" targetRef="Task_ArchiveCancelDecline" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveCancelDecline" name="Archive and Cancel Case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArchiveDecline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndDecline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Decline" name="Case Closed (Declined)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EndDecline</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndDecline" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveCancelDecline" targetRef="EndEvent_Decline" />

    <!-- Accept Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept" name="Accepted / Documents Received" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckResponse" targetRef="Gateway_CheckDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">response == 'accept'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckDocs" name="Check Prerequisite Documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocsComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocsMissing</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <!-- Docs Complete -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsComplete" name="All Docs Provided" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDocs" targetRef="Task_MoveToAdmin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">docsProvided == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MoveToAdmin" name="Move to Administration for Completion">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocsComplete</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Completion Started">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EndComplete</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndComplete" sourceRef="Task_MoveToAdmin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete" />

    <!-- Docs Missing -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsMissing" name="Docs Not Provided" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDocs" targetRef="Task_RequestDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">docsProvided == false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestDocs" name="Generate Message Requesting Outstanding Documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocsMissing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForDocs</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForDocs" name="Wait for Documents (2 Weeks)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForDocs</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckDocsAgain</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_2Weeks">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT2W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForDocs" sourceRef="Task_RequestDocs" targetRef="Event_WaitForDocs" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckDocsAgain" sourceRef="Event_WaitForDocs" targetRef="Gateway_CheckDocsFinal" />
    
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckDocsFinal" name="Received Docs?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckDocsAgain</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocsReceivedLate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAnswerTimeout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Late Docs Received -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsReceivedLate" name="Docs Received" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDocsFinal" targetRef="Task_MoveToAdmin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">docsReceived == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- No Answer Timeout -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAnswerTimeout" name="No Answer After 2 Weeks" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDocsFinal" targetRef="Task_UpdateCaseTimeout">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">docsReceived == false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateCaseTimeout" name="Update Case Details (Timeout)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAnswerTimeout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArchiveTimeout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchiveTimeout" sourceRef="Task_UpdateCaseTimeout" targetRef="Task_ArchiveCancelTimeout" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveCancelTimeout" name="Archive and Cancel Case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArchiveTimeout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndTimeout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Timeout" name="Case Closed (Timeout)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EndTimeout</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndTimeout" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveCancelTimeout" targetRef="EndEvent_Timeout" />

    <!-- Initial No Answer from first wait (Edge case handling if timer was on first event, but prompt implies specific flow for missing docs) -->
    <!-- The prompt says "If no answer is received after 2 weeks...". This usually applies to the request for outstanding documents phase based on context. 
         However, strictly reading: "waits for a reply... If no answer is received after 2 weeks [in general?]". 
         Given the structure "If customer sends back... If all pre-requisite not provided... message generated... If no answer after 2 weeks", 
         the 2 week timeout logically follows the request for outstanding documents. 
         I have modeled the timeout on the second wait state. 
         To be safe, I will add a timer to the first wait as well if interpreted globally, but standard BPMN practice for this narrative places the timeout on the specific pending action.
         Let's stick to the interpretation that the 2-week timeout applies to the "requesting outstanding documents" phase as it's the only place a duration is explicitly linked to a lack of response in the conditional chain.
    -->
